ops.text: ccx vcs ship's landing-store post runs cci post --attr title=<PR title>, and cci splits --attr on commas, so any PR title with a comma (cc-skills#3396: 'run at N = 100 on a pull request, 1,000 on main') fails with 'must be formatted as key=value' and the PR gets no landing-store row. Also SendMessage to meta-desk-3 by its lane name failed; the parent was reachable only as team-lead.
